content.title: MMSI Q3 Deep Dive: Product Innovation and Execution Drive Outperformance
content.summary: Medical device company Merit Medical Systems (NASDAQ:MMSI) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 CY2025, with sales up 13% year on year to $384.2 million. The company’s full-year revenue guidance of $1.51 billion at the midpoint came in 0.6% above analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.92 per share was 11.4% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
